description: Canonical Level 2 layer & subgraph catalog across Gemma 3 (270M, 1B, 4B), Gemma 4 (E2B, E4B, 31B), Qwen 3 (0.6B, 1.7B, 4B), and Qwen 3.5 (0.8B), with exact per-model layer multiplicities for DeltaT_runtime attribution.

Gemma3-270M.notes: 5:1 local SWA (W=512) to global full attention.

Gemma3-1B.notes: 5:1 local SWA (W=512) to global full attention; embed_dim=1152 != H_q*D=1024.

Gemma3-4B.notes: 5:1 local SWA (W=1024) to global full attention.

Gemma4-E2B.notes: 35 layers across 4 archetypes (Local/Global x KV-Producer/SharedKV) + PLE (256).

Gemma4-E4B.notes: 42 layers across 4 archetypes (Local/Global x KV-Producer/SharedKV) + PLE (256).

Gemma4-31B.notes: 60 layers: 50x Local SWA (D=256, H_kv=16, W=1024) + 10x Global Full (D=512, H_kv=4, K=V, R=128).

Qwen3-0.6B.notes: 28 homogeneous GQA (16:8, D=128) + SwiGLU blocks; embed_dim=1024 != H_q*D=2048.

Qwen3-4B.notes: 36 homogeneous GQA (32:8, D=128) + SwiGLU blocks; embed_dim=2560 != H_q*D=4096.
